product_metadata.title: National Tree 30 Inch Crestwood Spruce Wreath with Silver Bristles, Cones, Berries and 50 Battery Operated Warm White LED Lights with Timer (CW7-309L-30W-B1), 30 in, Green, Red
features: Trimmed with red berries, pine cones and glitter
Pre-strung with 50 UL listed Warm White LED Lights; Battery operated with integrated 6 hours On/18 hours Off timer
For Indoor or Covered Outdoor Display
description: The Crestwood Spruce is a sparkling mixed branch wreath featuring bristle tips and trimmed with pine cones, red berries and glitter. It is pre-strung with 50 battery-operated warm white LED lights that are energy-efficient and long lasting. 6 hours ON/18 hours OFF timed operation. This wreath can be displayed on doors, walls and windows in indoor or covered outdoor locations.
